build_generator_based_builder: create a GeneratorBasedBuilder subclass that yields examples and calls download_and_prepare to build a dataset
build_arrow_based_builder: create an ArrowBasedBuilder subclass that yields PyArrow tables and calls download_and_prepare to build a dataset
test_builder_config: test a custom BuilderConfig subclass with extra parameters like content and times for dataset builder configuration
run_download_and_prepare: run download_and_prepare on a DatasetBuilder to generate Arrow or Parquet files for dataset splits
